critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/account/delete: wipes documents + cis_payments + password_reset_tokens + payment_transactions + users in 5 sequential awaits — atomic enough for single-user delete, no transaction needed since each collection is per-user. Returns 200 with friendly message. ✓
server.py /api/account/delete: token isn't invalidated separately — get_user lookup will 401 automatically once the user doc is gone. ✓ Verified by test_delete_account_wipes_user_and_related_data.
ToolHeader.jsx no-liability-footer: hardcoded styles (10px font, #666 grey, semi-transparent gold border) match spec. Mounts inside result-actions fragment so only appears post-generate. ✓
Signup.jsx: submit button has both 'disabled' attribute AND 'morris-disabled-pulse' CSS class — animated pulse confirmed via attribute snapshot. ✓
Profile.jsx danger zone: confirm button is disabled until input value === 'DELETE' exact match (case-sensitive). ✓ Tested.
Landing.jsx logo swap: appears twice (navbar + footer mark) instead of the old gold 'M' square. ✓
PrivacyPolicy.jsx: lists Anthropic, Emergent, Stripe, Resend exactly as spec'd. Vercel→Emergent substitution confirmed in rendered DOM.
App.js: /terms and /privacy are public (no auth wrapper) — verified by direct GET without login. /app/privacy, /app/complaints, /app/refund-policy require auth. ✓

Sidebar Account section is collapsed by default — Privacy Policy / Terms / Complaints / Refund Policy links only render when expanded. Per-design (consistent with iteration-3 billing link), not a bug.
CookieBanner localStorage key 'morris_cookie_consent' set to 'accepted' on click — banner hidden on subsequent reloads in same browser. ✓
